spans.s: cl. 1. P. ओहति, उवोह, औहीत्, &c., to give pain, hurt, kill, L. (cf. 1. ऊह्.)

1. ऊह् cl. 1. P. Ā. ऊहति, -ते, ऊहांचकार and -चक्रे, ऊहिता, औहीत्, औहिष्ट (connected with √ वह्, q.v., and in some forms not to be distinguished from it), to push, thrust, move, remove (only when compounded with prepositions);
to change, alter, modify, ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on Nyāyam.
